title: C23 — Bitget USDT-M Out-of-Sample Cross-Venue Replication (SPEC_LITERAL_NEXT_OPEN)
why_c23: C1-C20 closed NO_GO on OKX + Binance UM perps; C21-T1 confirmed temporal/regime stability of that NO_GO; C22 (MEXC, new venue) also closed NO_GO with 0/36 BH survivors and a negative pooled total. Before declaring the edge dead, C23 asks the last NEW-DATA question: does the unchanged spec-literal edge replicate on a second independent never-used venue (Bitget USDT-M)? New data + frozen spec, not a rerun.

strata.definition: venue funding rate sign at crash day; neutral when venue has no funding history

inference.pooled: venue-blocked bootstrap over fold totals + cross-venue sign concordance vs recorded OKX/Binance/MEXC

decision_rules.STABLE_POSITIVE_SUBSET: >=1 pre-specified venue-fold or pooled stratum survives BH correction with bootstrap CI excluding 0 & positive spot leg, permutation p<0.05, placebo p_ge_canonical<0.05, effective N>= floor, AND same-direction effect in the other venue(s) or flagged single-venue exploratory (Bitget is the new venue; OKX/Binance/MEXC are the recorded priors).
decision_rules.NO_GO: no stratum survives BH correction; pooled CI spans 0; spot non-positive across most folds (corroborates the C1-C22 NO_GO).
decision_rules.UNDERPOWERED: per-fold N below floor, or missing seed/SHA binding / compute predating this prereg.
decision_rules.rule: Always report per-fold, per-venue, and pooled numbers plus the power curve — never a bare token.

provenance.provenance_caveat: Real Bitget USDT-M perpetual exchange data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NOT Hyperliquid performance evidence and must never be relabelled as such. Multi-year window 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z..2026-09-28T23:00:00Z (32808 hourly bars/symbol).

guardrails: Cross-venue real Bitget data only; never relabel as Hyperliquid (is_hyperliquid_venue_data=false).
Config is FROZEN to the spec-literal values above; no parameter tuning after results.
Folds and strata are fixed here, before compute; no post-hoc bin/fold invention.
Do NOT reduce draw counts: 20k bootstrap / 20k permutation / 2k placebo / 2k strata floors preserved.
No synthetic gap-fill; symbols not listed for the full window are excluded (coverage=false), never fabricated.
The C1-C22 NO_GO stands unless C23 produces a pre-registered contradiction with full evidence.
Bitget is the NEW venue; a same-data rerun on OKX/Binance/MEXC is forbidden. New direction beyond C23 needs new prereg + new data + explicit authorization.
Report per-fold, per-venue, and pooled numbers plus the power curve — never a bare token.
